representation.artifact_format: DoclingDocument JSON from export_to_dict, reloadable with DoclingDocument.model_validate_json
representation.downstream_consumer: Docling HybridChunker in a later Chunking Task; Phase 3 must not break direct DoclingDocument consumption
representation.text_normalization_target: TextItem.text and TableCell.text; TextItem.orig keeps the extracted text before normalization
representation.bizaid_metadata_location: parse result envelope outside DoclingDocument; DocumentOrigin.mimetype is not the BizAid format source because docling-core rejects HWP/HWPX MIME values

docling_core.reason: DoclingDocument model, TableData and JSON reload for HwpxDoclingAdapter without Docling converter or model weights

docling.reason: the docling meta package equals docling-slim[standard], which also installs OCR engines (rapidocr, opencv) and office/chunking extras; the PDF-only extras keep OCR engines absent
docling.compatibility: docling-slim 2.130.0 requires docling-core>=2.96.0,<3.0.0; resolved with the existing docling-core==2.99.0 and pydantic==2.13.5, pip check clean
docling.introduction_rule: docling-slim and docling-core are changed together after a resolver check; no ad hoc upgrade or downgrade
docling.metadata_rule: parse_key and parser metadata record the versions actually installed at parse time

model_artifacts.identity: model_artifacts_sha256 = SHA-256 over folder/file path and file SHA-256 of every file listed in models[].files; files outside the list are ignored; must equal expected_manifest_sha256 before conversion; part of parse_key
model_artifacts.runtime_download: forbidden in parsing and test runtime; a missing path or folder fails before conversion
model_artifacts.provisioning: explicit step outside test runtime: scripts/provision_docling_artifacts.py provision --allow-network downloads models[].files at resolved_snapshot into a staging folder and moves it only after identity verification; CI restores it from the GitHub Actions cache keyed by artifacts_cache_key
model_artifacts.scope: Docling layout model, the six PP-TableMagic table models and the two PP-OCRv5 OCR models share one pinned artifacts directory, identity and CI cache; TableFormer weights are not listed

docling.companion_pin: docling-ibm-models[opencv-python-headless]==4.0.3 declares opencv for layout post-processing; opencv-python-headless is pinned to 4.10.0.84 to equal the opencv-contrib-python version required by paddlex so both distributions ship the same cv2 build; opencv is not an OCR engine

paddle.reason: PP-TableMagic is the production PDF table engine (user decision 2026-09-29 after 3-B.1 to 3-B.4 evidence)
paddle.ocr_extra: table_recognition_v2 is declared with pipeline_requires_extra('ocr') and checks the extra's installed distributions; the extra is installed only to satisfy that check and no OCR model is configured or loaded
paddle.resolver_effect: numpy 2.4.6 -> 2.3.5 and PyYAML 6.0.3 -> 6.0.2 within docling ranges; paddleocr is not installed
paddle.metadata_rule: parse_key records installed paddlepaddle and paddlex versions

input.unit: unique document_sources.content_sha256 with download_status=ACQUIRED and verified s3_* metadata
input.binary_source: S3 object read through S3DocumentStore.read with byte size and SHA-256 re-verification
input.local_disk: fixture, scratch and bounded temporary processing only; never a persistent parsed artifact store
input.provenance: results are keyed by content SHA; every relation is recovered by joining document_sources.content_sha256 and is never deduplicated away

count_basis.unique_content_sha: distinct document_sources.content_sha256; one binary is parsed once
count_basis.source_relation: document_sources rows; provenance of pblanc_id, source field and token, never counted as documents
count_basis.reporting_rule: every parsing count names its basis as unique_content_sha or source_relation; the two are never summed or substituted

artifact_storage.original_binary: S3 existing content-addressed objects; no re-upload
artifact_storage.parse_metadata: MySQL: parsing status, provenance, artifact pointer, parser metadata
artifact_storage.local_filesystem: fixture, scratch and temporary processing only
artifact_storage.implementation_status: implemented by Phase 3 persistence with Flyway V5
artifact_storage.serialization: sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON from DoclingDocument.export_to_dict; no Markdown artifact
artifact_storage.idempotency: source_sha256 + parse_key is the MySQL primary key and immutable S3 address; identical reruns verify and reuse both
artifact_storage.new_parse_key: a new parse_key creates a different object and row without overwriting prior results
artifact_storage.commit_order: serialize and reload -> artifact SHA/size -> conditional S3 PUT or verified reuse -> HEAD and full-byte readback -> MySQL transaction
artifact_storage.non_success: non-PARSED status stores metadata only and never creates a DoclingDocument artifact

orchestration.execution_unit: one to three unique document_sources.content_sha256 values explicitly supplied by the caller

batch_boundary.selection: caller-supplied only; the command never discovers or scans sources
batch_boundary.order: ascending source_sha256 for deterministic sequential execution
batch_boundary.failure_isolation: one source failure is recorded and does not roll back or skip the other explicitly supplied sources

orchestration.source_requirement: all ACQUIRED relations for the SHA have complete and consistent verified s3_* metadata
orchestration.source_read: S3DocumentStore.read_key verifies object key, byte size and SHA-256 before parse_document
sequence: S3 source read and integrity verification
orchestration.reuse: orchestration does not add a duplicate check; source_sha256 + parse_key reuse belongs to persistence
orchestration.live_scope: real AWS read/write and corpus execution require a separately approved explicit run

PDF.flow: source bytes -> integrity check -> DocumentStream (no temp file) -> Docling DocumentConverter (do_ocr=false, do_table_structure=false) -> independently select low-native-text pages for PP-OCRv5 -> PP-TableMagic table detection and structure with OCR text on selected pages and native text elsewhere -> detection-edge grid adapter -> table quality gate -> assembly into the same DoclingDocument -> normalize_document -> apply_gate
PDF.reuse: HWP_PDF_DOCLING calls the same PDF boundary after conversion; PDF logic is not duplicated

table_engine.text_injection: native PDF text rectangles as overall_ocr_res (3-B.3 A/B: rectangle kept, native_words injection rejected)
table_engine.cell_text_source: native PDF words assigned to grid cells by word center
table_engine.ocr_rule: no OCR submodule is configured or loaded; the pipeline fails rather than running OCR
table_engine.cpu_kernel_rule: oneDNN (MKLDNN) is disabled on every platform so macOS arm64 (wheel without oneDNN) and Linux x86_64 (wheel with oneDNN) run the same Paddle CPU path; paddlepaddle 3.3.1 PIR oneDNN raises NotImplementedError for the layout model on Linux; flags are set before paddlex import and verified, otherwise the engine fails
table_engine.ocr_required_rule: the table engine reads the OCR text layer on independently selected low-native-text pages and native text on all other pages

ocr.engine: paddlex OCR pipeline (PP-OCRv5 text detection + Korean text recognition)
ocr.trigger: each PDF page whose native PDF text is at or below document_gate.pdf_ocr_required_max_chars_per_page is selected independently; document-average text never suppresses OCR for a low-text page
ocr.page_rule: a page is OCRed when its native text is at or below document_gate.pdf_ocr_required_max_chars_per_page and either it has no native text or it contains a raster image object; a low-text page whose content is native text only keeps native text; every other page keeps native text and never invokes OCR
ocr.model_choice: PP-OCRv5_mobile_det instead of server_det: on the 1-page sample both found 50 lines, server_det needed 13.3 s and about 10 GB RSS, mobile_det 5.4 s and 1.8 GB; not an accuracy benchmark
ocr.text_layer: OCR lines replace the native text rectangles injected into PP-TableMagic and OCR words (line text split by spaces, x range by character share) replace native words for table cells
ocr.provenance: each OCR text item keeps bizaid__ocr with source_sha256, page, bbox_pt, confidence and engine identity; ParseResult.ocr records engine, OCR pages and insufficient OCR pages
ocr.not_vlm: general OCR only; PaddleOCR-VL visual parsing stays deferred
ocr.failure: an OCR engine error is PARSE_FAILED ocr_engine_error:<ExceptionClass>; a selected page whose OCR text stays at or below the gate is reported by OCR_TEXT_INSUFFICIENT and ocr.insufficient_pages, while the document status follows the document text gate (a blank or page-number-only page cannot be told apart from an unreadable scan without guessing, and a non-PARSED status would drop the whole document artifact)

PDF.docling_ocr: Docling's own OCR stays disabled (do_ocr=false); BizAid OCR runs outside Docling on OCR_REQUIRED pages only

HWP.scope: HWP (HWP5 binary) only; HWPX keeps the native HwpxDoclingAdapter route
HWP.flow: S3 HWP bytes -> integrity check -> temporary directory -> dedicated Docker converter (LibreOffice headless + H2Orestart, no network) -> intermediate PDF bytes -> parse_pdf (the production PDF route: Docling backbone + PP-TableMagic) -> DoclingDocument; temporary files are removed

converter.decision: LibreOffice headless + H2Orestart in a dedicated Docker image (user approval 2026-09-29); no host installation
converter.libreoffice: Debian package version at build time, written to /opt/bizaid/libreoffice-version (observed 25.2.3.2)

licenses.H2Orestart: GPL-3.0, run as a separate process and not linked

converter.identity: converter_version = LibreOffice version + H2Orestart version + dockerfile_sha256 prefix read from the verified image; part of parse_key
converter.image_rule: the image must carry image_label equal to dockerfile_sha256; a missing or different image is CONVERSION_FAILED, never a host fallback
converter.validation: contract tests replace the docker call; real conversion is checked by a targeted run of at most 3 HWP documents, not in check-all

HWP.provenance: source_sha256 in parse_key and bizaid item provenance stays the original HWP SHA; the intermediate PDF SHA-256, size and converter_version are recorded in ParseResult.derivation only; the intermediate PDF is not persisted
HWP.image_only_rule: a converted PDF without native text follows the PDF OCR_REQUIRED rule unchanged

HWPX.flow: S3 HWPX bytes -> bounded ZIP container read -> Contents/header.xml declarations + section XML (spine order) -> HwpxDoclingAdapter -> DoclingDocument

quality_status.execution_evidence: 3 real HWPX documents (targeted) and synthetic fixtures

limited.Heading: no real document in the targeted set has non-empty explicit outline headings; the rule is fixed by synthetic fixtures

structure_rules.source: only explicit HWPX declarations: paraPr heading type (OUTLINE / NUMBER / BULLET, idRef, level), built-in outline style name or engName (개요 N / Outline N), and control names (header, footer, footNote, endNote)
structure_rules.heading: paraPr heading OUTLINE level L -> section header level L+1; built-in outline style N -> level N; user-defined style names, font size or layout are never used
structure_rules.list: paraPr heading NUMBER or BULLET -> list item in a list group; consecutive paragraphs with the same numbering or bullet declaration share one group; bullet marker is the declared char; numbers are not computed and the numbering format is kept in provenance
structure_rules.notes: header / footer text -> page_header / page_footer in the furniture layer; footNote / endNote text -> footnote
structure_rules.table: cellAddr / cellSpan grid as before; a cell containing an explicit list or a nested table becomes a RichTableCell referencing a group under the table, and its flattened text stays in cell.text; headings are not created inside table cells
structure_rules.unrepresentable: structure that cannot be represented keeps its text with a warning or provenance note; nothing is silently dropped
structure_rules.no_special_case: no rule depends on a document SHA, file name or fixture

HWPX.provenance: every item carries bizaid__hwpx: source_sha256, section entry name, XML path from the section root (for example p[3]/run[0]/tbl[0]/tr[1]/tc[0]/subList[0]/p[0]), paragraph id, style, paraPr id, structure evidence and container; HWPX has no page or coordinates, so no ProvenanceItem page/bbox is created

XLSX.approved_direction: Docling Excel route candidate; not implemented

ZIP.subtype_policy: DOCX / PPTX / ODT support routes are decided in a later Parser scope
ZIP.activation_rule: Generic ZIP extraction stays POLICY_PENDING until a contract represents every member provenance field

OTHER.approved_direction: image binaries become OCR_REQUIRED; not implemented

table_engine.change_policy: primary table engine changes only after a BizAid corpus benchmark and a user decision
table_engine.document_parser: Docling remains the PDF document parser regardless of the table engine
table_engine.representation: any table engine converges to DoclingDocument TableItem through a table-only adapter; no own canonical document
table_engine.routing_rule: deterministic rules on features known before conversion; failure-triggered retry with another engine is not a primary fix

evaluation.phase4_gate: Chunking, Embedding and Qdrant stay blocked until this evaluation is decided

suitability_gate.task: 3-B.2 PP-TableMagic Production Suitability Gate; 3-B.3 PDF Hybrid Parsing Validation

candidate_architecture.table_owner: PP-TableMagic table detection and table structure

suitability_gate.docling_bbox_gate: Docling table bbox -> PP structure is attribution-only and not the default candidate; Docling missed 4 of 19 GT tables in 3-B.1
suitability_gate.no_automatic_regression: an unsuitable verdict does not revert to TableFormer or Camelot; alternatives are decided in a separate Task

table_quality.mapping_rule: structure cells map to logical TableCell only through a proven rule; an unproven mapping is TABLE_QUALITY_FAILED, never a silent fallback
table_quality.downstream_rule: TABLE_QUALITY_FAILED tables must not enter Chunking or indexing

failed_table_policy.structure: no TableItem, row, column or span structure is created
failed_table_policy.text: all native PDF text inside the table bbox is preserved without loss as non-table text
failed_table_policy.downstream: not a structured table; the Chunking and indexing block of downstream_rule still applies
failed_table_policy.automatic_fallback: no other table parser is tried
failed_table_policy.overlapping_regions: overlapping PP regions (container or duplicate candidates) are not resolved by choosing one; their union bbox is preserved as TABLE_QUALITY_FAILED native text until a verified rule exists

table_engine.assembly_rule: assembly into DoclingDocument never drops native text: a replaced Docling item keeps its non-replaced children (caption, footnote) as items, TABLE_VALID words outside every cell stay as text with provenance, each native word belongs to one owner: words inside a PP region belong to the PP result and any native item overlapping the region keeps only its words outside every PP region (an item with none left is removed), Docling table text outside the PP region stays as text, picture child text inside a PP region is owned by that region, a PP region overlapping a Docling picture is recorded for human review, and silent loss is judged per page against the Docling baseline, not by document totals; OCR pages replace native content of every content layer, including furniture; an insertion anchor ties on the same row resolve to the last item in document order
table_engine.decision: 2026-09-29 user decision: replace_with_pp_tablemagic; Docling stays the document backbone; TableFormer is not run
table_engine.docling_table_rule: a Docling table region that no PP region owns becomes non-table native text of its bbox (TableFormer is disabled, so no structure is invented)
table_engine.uncertain_regions: overlapping, container or duplicate PP regions are preserved as TABLE_QUALITY_FAILED native text; no region is chosen until a verified rule exists

visual_pilot.engine: PaddleOCR-VL in the separate benchmark environment only
visual_pilot.scope: informative visual candidates only (chart, diagram, flowchart, screenshot, other informative); not every picture and not an OCR fallback for scanned pages
visual_pilot.supported_tasks: model task prompts only (OCR, Spotting, Chart Recognition, Table Recognition); unsupported schemas such as free captions or entities are not forced
visual_pilot.evidence_semantics: visual outputs are model-derived evidence, never native source text, and stay distinguishable in DoclingDocument
visual_pilot.quality_rule: execution success is not content quality; execution error, empty output, confirmed repetitive degeneration or Han script absent from the page native text in a Korean source (evaluation candidate) is VISUAL_QUALITY_FAILED; no unevidenced output schema or semantic threshold is forced and unverifiable content remains human-review pending
visual_pilot.production_status: deferred: PaddleOCR-VL is not part of the production PDF route and is not imported by production code; Docling picture items are kept as-is without VLM parsing

parse_status_semantics.PARSED: parser execution succeeded, the DoclingDocument reloads from JSON and passes the text-quantity gate; it does not guarantee semantic or table fidelity
parse_status_semantics.consumer_rule: downstream consumers must read warnings and table item metadata; bizaid__table_quality verdict TABLE_QUALITY_FAILED marks non-structured table text that must not be treated as a table
parse_status_semantics.warning_counts: PDF_TABLE_* warnings count table regions of each kind in one document
parse_status_semantics.CONVERSION_FAILED: the source-to-PDF conversion did not produce a PDF; no document is produced and no other parser is tried

failure_codes.rule: status names the outcome class; failure_code names the concrete cause and is null for PARSED, EMPTY_TEXT and OCR_REQUIRED

versioning.parse_key: SHA-256 of sorted compact UTF-8 JSON of parse_key_inputs; inputs outside the route scope are null; docling_version is the installed docling-slim version
versioning.skip_rule: an existing result is reused only when parse_key is identical and the stored artifact size and SHA-256 re-verify
versioning.reprocess_rule: a changed component version yields a new parse_key only for documents on that route; previous results and artifacts are kept and never overwritten

hwpx_adapter_version_history.1: HWPX text as paragraphs, strings-only table cells
hwpx_adapter_version_history.2: HWPX explicit headings, lists, notes, furniture, RichTableCell for structured cells, bizaid__hwpx provenance

route_scope.rule: a component identity is filled only on routes whose output it can change; other inputs stay null; a normalizer or DoclingDocument (docling-core) change affects every route

normalization.removed: C0 control characters except TAB and LF, and DEL
normalization.not_changed: wording, spacing inside a line, numbers, dates, table cell boundaries

document_gate.text_metric: non-whitespace characters over normalized TextItem.text and TableCell.text
document_gate.status_rule: PARSED requires a DoclingDocument that reloads from its JSON artifact and has more than empty_text_max_chars; a completed parser call without text is never PARSED

hwpx_container_limits.xml_parser: defusedxml; DTD, entity and external reference are rejected

run_gate_pass: every input SHA has exactly one result for the current parse_key; every PARSED artifact reloads as DoclingDocument and its SHA-256 re-verifies; every result joins back to at least one document_sources relation; status and warning counts per detected_format are reported; failure-rate acceptance is a Human Review decision, not automatic
pending_decisions: DOCX / PPTX / ODT routes and Generic ZIP member provenance contract
HwpxDoclingAdapter broader quality validation (3-document targeted check done; real explicit headings not yet observed)

corpus_execution.profile: dev only; prod corpus execution is refused
corpus_execution.unit: unique content SHA of verified acquired sources
corpus_execution.targets: formats whose route is enabled; other formats are counted as unsupported/inactive and never recorded as parsed
corpus_execution.execution: sequential, concurrency 1; the parser runs in one child process that is replaced after a timeout or crash
corpus_execution.resume: a source whose current parse_key already has a row with a skip status is not reprocessed; sources without a row (execution failure, timeout) run again; --retry-failed also reruns retry_statuses
corpus_execution.failure_isolation: one source failure is recorded and the next source runs
corpus_execution.environment_stop: consecutive storage, credential, schema or worker-start failures stop the run as STOPPED_ENVIRONMENT instead of marking remaining sources failed
corpus_execution.observability: data/parsed/corpus-runs/<run-id>/progress.json and results.jsonl (ignored); --status prints total, completed, remaining, statuses, skipped, current and elapsed
corpus_execution.immutability: existing artifacts and rows are never deleted or overwritten; persistence keeps its INSERTED / REUSED / UPDATED rules
corpus_execution.upper_bound: --max-completed N stops before starting a new source once completed (processed + skipped current-key) reaches N
corpus_execution.graceful_stop: SIGTERM / SIGINT request a stop at the next source boundary; the in-flight source finishes and persists; the runner kills its worker only on source_timeout
corpus_execution.reprocess: --sources-file limits a run to listed enabled verified SHAs so a fix reprocesses only affected sources; parse_key idempotency is unchanged
